text.content:
The other side of the NUSA's coin.

Industry: Weapons, military vehicles and private military forces
Leadership: Rosalind Myers, former CEO, is now President of the NUSA
In Night City: A regional HQ in the Corporate Plaza; never far from NUSA business
Dealing with edgerunners: Hires them for jobs it can't send its own troops on

One of the world's largest makers of weapons and military vehicles, from pistols to missiles. Most NUSA military gear carries its logo, and it rents out private armies to anyone who can pay.

Militech fought Arasaka in the 4th Corporate War until President Kress nationalized it. Over the decades the relationship flipped: today Militech has more sway over the NUSA than the NUSA has over Militech.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.24
